environment.daemon: local unix or npipe endpoint only

capacity.author_policy_memory_note: ReSteer README estimates about 10 GB for serving; not measured here.
capacity.driver: NVIDIA CUDA 12 and EGL capable; verify in Docker. No host driver/runtime install performed.

policy.weight_sha256_manifest: Computed only after Docker assets stage; currently absent
policy.policy_rng_source: Pinned openpi Policy defaults to jax.random.key(0); fresh server for each single probe.

qualification.purpose: Transport and queued-action replacement qualification; no task-success comparison.
qualification.source_prompt: put the bowl on the plate
qualification.target_prompt: put the bowl on top of the cabinet
qualification.split: one dev qualification only; no cal/test/holdout
qualification.pass_rule: GPU-backed policy process; nonempty finite observations; two valid action replies; target query at switch step 2; executed actions match new queue after switch; no environment exception.
qualification.failure_rule: Record exact stage and stop; no CPU/MPS fallback or extra sweep.
qualification.goal_success: Record upstream first-hit flag as context only; neither required nor sufficient for IO qualification.
qualification.baselines: Not a research comparison; atomic source/target are existing ReSteer tasks.
qualification.ablation: None in P0; R1/R4 O/A and R7 remain later work.
qualification.control_hz: Read env.control_freq at runtime; do not infer from dataset fps.

not_implemented: R1/R4 temporal constraint observer and tolerances
same-state multi-arm branch and controller/RNG restoration verification
